text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Cafe. Happy birthday. I left a present 
on your desk, so please go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not too well-versed in coffee, you 
see. I played it safe and got you a mug as 
a present, but please feel free to use it 
if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What did you put in the cup?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahaha! Talking under the assumption 
that it's all rigged... in a way, I can 
feel how much you trust me!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There's... no way you would... give an 
ordinary present...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There was! And that was held today! On 
your very birthday!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Go ahead and try it out for now. Come on, 
it's just a celebratory gesture. No 
ulterior motives."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, in that case, whether your suspicion 
has enough psychological impact to cause 
your hand to slip while brewing coffee—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As long as you let me closely observe all 
of that, I'll be more than satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...There's literally *nothing but* an 
ulterior motive here...
